companies.name: Aaptiv
companies.description: Comprehensive fitness for every body and every goal
companies.funding_notes: aaptiv.com, NYC audio fitness app. Announced Series A $12M and Series B $26M (Dec 2017, Insight lead) then Series C $22M (Jun 2018, Millennium lead) bringing total to over $52M per company PR; earlier seed amounts not separately detailed in those releases. Acquired by PEAR Sports (Oct 2021; terms undisclosed).

companies.name: Abstractive
companies.description: AI medical record summaries and clinical Q&A for providers

NSF SBIR Phase II award $1.25M (Jul 2025–Jun 2027). Total equity round size beyond HEALWELL tranche not publicly disclosed.

companies.name: Acely

companies.funding_notes: acely.com. Acely is the AI SAT/ACT tutor launched Jan 2024 as a spinout product from Juni Learning (YC W18; same founding lineage). Public priced funding found under Juni Learning: $10.5M Series A (Aug 2020). YC page says backed by Forerunner and ~$10M ARR; no separate Acely-named priced round amount found. Pear listed Acely as Seed on portfolio—treat Juni Series A as the public seed+ evidence. Juni Learning's $10.5M Series A (Aug 2020) belongs to the parent company, so it is not counted as Acely's own round; no Acely-specific priced round is public (Pear lists it as a portfolio company).
